title: as2 source
description: Receives documents by AS2 (RFC 4130): an HTTP server on serverPortNumber that decrypts, checks the signature, decompresses and makes a message of every document; the body is the document, with the headers AS2-From, AS2-To, AS2-Message-Id, Subject, file.name, AS2-Signed, AS2-Encrypted, AS2-Compressed and AS2-Signer. The receipt (MDN) answers in the same exchange after the flow has processed the message. Asynchronous receipts are not supported.

address.title: Address
address.description: Local address to listen on; all if empty

requestUriPattern.title: Request URI
requestUriPattern.description: Path the endpoint serves, such as /AS2InboundSigned; a pattern that ends in * is a prefix, and * is every path

as2MessageStructure.title: Structure
as2MessageStructure.description: What a message must have: SIGNED, ENCRYPTED and the like (see the as2 action) require a valid signature or encryption; others accept everything and read compression when it is there

messageStructure.title: Structure (alias)
messageStructure.description: Used when as2MessageStructure is not set

decryptingPrivateKey.title: Decrypting key
decryptingPrivateKey.description: The private key of the certificate partners encrypt for: PEM text, the address (http:// or https://) of PEM, or the path of a PEM file or PKCS#12 keystore (opened with password)

signingPrivateKey.title: Signing key
signingPrivateKey.description: The private key (and certificate) that signs the receipts a sender asks to be signed: PEM text, the address (http:// or https://) of PEM, or the path of a PEM file or PKCS#12 keystore (opened with password)

signingCertificateChain.title: Signing certificate
signingCertificateChain.description: The certificate chain of signingPrivateKey: PEM text, the address (http:// or https://) of PEM, or the path of a PEM file or PKCS#12 keystore (opened with password)

validateSigningCertificateChain.title: Partner certificates
validateSigningCertificateChain.description: The certificates a signer must be one of, or be issued by; without it any valid signature passes, which proves the message is whole but not who sent it: PEM text, the address (http:// or https://) of PEM, or the path of a PEM file or PKCS#12 keystore (opened with password)

password.title: Keystore password
password.description: Password of a PKCS#12 keystore in one of the key options

serverFqdn.title: Server name
serverFqdn.description: Host name in the Message-ID of the receipts

as2From.title: AS2-From
as2From.description: Accepted for compatibility; the identifiers of the message are not checked

as2To.title: AS2-To
as2To.description: Accepted for compatibility; the identifiers of the message are not checked

alias.title: Key alias
alias.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

keyAlias.title: Key alias
keyAlias.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

flowNameAsEndpoint.title: Flow name as endpoint
flowNameAsEndpoint.description: Accepted for compatibility; requestUriPattern is the path

serverIdentityFile.title: TLS identity
serverIdentityFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the server's key and certificate to listen over TLS; plain HTTP if empty

serverIdentityPassword.title: TLS identity password
serverIdentityPassword.description: Password of serverIdentityFile; env DIF_SERVER_IDENTITY_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds a call may take, and the fetch of a key from an address

connectTimeout.title: Connect timeout
connectTimeout.description: Milliseconds the connection may take to set up

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust for https calls (also to fetch keys); "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)
